label: Soldier Twist (3D: a character dances on the card)

preset.title: Off Duty
preset.intro: Lay the card flat and point your phone at it. At ease: the sergeant is about to dance.
body: New orders from Birthday Command: boots stay on, rank comes off, and you twist until the cake arrives.
You are the toughest person I know and the softest when it counts. Happy birthday. Take the night off. That is an order.
preset.from: With love, your most loyal private

groups.title: The board
groups.note: The words on the board that comes up when the dance ends. Up to about 40 letters; longer words get smaller.

rows.label: Board
rows.value: Chúc mừng sinh nhật, Trung sĩ!
